story.review_method: Read complete original and complete revision, compare changed paragraphs and preserved incident sequence. Prose review only; no illustration clearance.

observations: Independent reviewer opened all three current sheets at native resolution, originals and native detail crops; no material findings. Qualitative scale and grooming states remain provisional.

Neet four fine grounded legs, real trunk and short nub; projecting barking muzzle and broad triangular ears preserve identity. Buddy four owned feet and continuous longer torso behind, pale muzzle/brows and pendant ear hair; low tapering tail corrected.
Gnome stays still/smiling, mouth sizes show Neet committed bark versus Buddy tentative support; backyard flower border matches ending. No material staging defect.
All3 current images inspected full-resolution; coat and nub defects closed on actual Max v005 replacement.

observations.comedy_and_timing: Occupancy declaration is a short pause after noisy motion; slipper success has a visible stillness beat. Max paw-check literalizes his confusion, and following the relocated foot earns Both feet, then? Buddy losing several wonderful seconds links his peaceful choice to the interruption. The gnome remaining cheerful gives the opposing threat no actual menace.
observations.voices_and_agency: Neet stays disproportionately combative; Max stays gentle and puzzled; Heather punctures Neet with practical removal and affectionate size comparison. Buddy seeks rest, moves the slipper, selects flowers, leaves them, tries his own bark and finally retrieves Neet. His final decision changes the outcome rather than merely commenting.
observations.causality_and_emotion: Wake-up leads to kitchen refuge; park conflict causes Heather to carry Neet; arriving home exposes the gnome; invitation alone fails, while Buddy nose contact brings Neet inside. Shared slipper transforms Buddy initial exclusion into chosen companionship. Final two short paragraphs give the callback room without an explanatory coda.
observations.breakfast_placement: After Neet accepts Occupied and resumes patrol; Buddy eyes closed and Neet walking away, not still sniffing slipper. Heather matching slipper and sock add quiet context without new plot.
observations.max_placement: After Max raises one paw, before Buddy leaves flowers and before rear-leg bouncing. Current V005 visibly preserves all three states. Large gentle figure against small barking dog supplies scale comedy, and distant Buddy sniffing supplies competing desire.
observations.gnome_placement: After tentative supporting bark and before Buddy sits. Both dogs stand and unequal mouth openings distinguish commitment. Smiling stationary gnome carries the comic nonresponse.
observations.complementarity_and_readability: Three settings and different compositions cover territorial refuge, scale misunderstanding and unequal solidarity. No illustration interrupts dialogue attribution or depicts final shared refuge prematurely. Text remains comfortably readable; all images load. Max bodies are visibly flatter than breakfast and gnome, as independent visual review acknowledged; character identities, scene and warm environmental palette remain legible. No material reading defect.
